The brand-new iPhone 18 Pro has significantly improved battery life compared to its predecessor, and wired charging is even faster.

Apple says that to fast-charge the new iPhone, you'll need its 40W Dynamic Charger, which supports up to 60W output, paired with a USB-C cable. With this combination, you can charge at maximum speed — roughly 33% faster than previous Pro iPhones.

The iPhone 18 Pro's peak charging speed with a 60W charger means you can go from zero to 50% in about 15 minutes. That's around 5 minutes faster than the iPhone 17 Pro.

Apple also notes that at this faster charging rate, a quick 5-minute top-up gives users roughly 6 hours of video playback.

Specifically, Apple's fast-charging time spec for the new iPhone 18 requires a 60W charger that's compatible with USB PD 3.1 and offers an Adjustable Voltage Supply (AVS) function. Right now, the only widely available charger that meets these requirements is Apple's own 40W Dynamic Charger.

Once we get our hands on the device, we'll be able to run our own battery charging time tests with third-party chargers to see how they perform. For instance, the MacBook charger you may already own at home is typically rated at 96W or 140W, but lacks the Adjustable Voltage Supply function.

There are plenty of third-party chargers rated above 40W on the market too, such as this 45W Anker charging brick. The iPhone 18 Pro is expected to perform similarly to the iPhone 17 Pro, going from zero to 50% in about 20 minutes via a third-party charger. If you're in a rush, that's still pretty fast.

For wireless charging, the iPhone 18 Pro paired with an Apple MagSafe charger and any 35W charger can go from 0 to 50% in about 30 minutes.

The iPhone 18 Pro will be available for pre-order starting this Saturday, with the first batch shipping on September 18. When Apple's foldable iPhone Duo launches next month, it will support the same faster charging speeds as the iPhone 18 Pro, provided it's paired with the appropriate accessories mentioned above.

Remember, Apple no longer includes a charger in the box — just a USB-C cable.
